```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(gstat)
library(ranger)
library(yardstick)
library(tidyterra)

dir.create("../outputs/spatial", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r load-inputs}
# ============================================================
# LOAD INPUTS
# ============================================================

if (!exists("cov_stack")) {
  cov_stack <- terra::rast(
    "../data/spatial/covariate_stack_3m_all_with_SR_indices.tif"
  )
}

if (!exists("soil_pts")) {
  soil_pts <- sf::st_read(
    "../data/spatial/perry_pedon_locs.shp", quiet = TRUE
  ) %>%
    sf::st_transform(crs = sf::st_crs(terra::crs(cov_stack))) %>%
    rename(Point = Point_ID) %>%
    mutate(Point = as.character(Point))
}

if (!exists("cov_at_pedons")) {
  cov_at_pedons <- read.csv(
    "../outputs/spatial/covariates_at_pedons.csv"
  ) %>%
    mutate(Point = as.character(Point))
}

perry_fp_clean <- read.csv(
  "../data/Perry_FP_data_with_taxa_02_20_2026.csv"
) %>%
  mutate(Point = as.character(Point))

cat("Inputs loaded.\n")
cat("Perry horizons:", nrow(perry_fp_clean), "\n")
```

```{r compute-sand-150}
# ============================================================
# COMPUTE WEIGHTED AVERAGE SAND 0-150 CM PER PEDON
# ============================================================

# Parse top/bottom depths from To.Depth..cm. column
parse_depths <- function(x) {
  top <- as.numeric(str_extract(x, "^\\d+"))
  bot <- as.numeric(str_extract(x, "(?<=-)\\d+"))
  tibble(top_cm = top, bottom_cm = bot)
}

perry_hz <- perry_fp_clean %>%
  bind_cols(parse_depths(.$To.Depth..cm.)) %>%
  mutate(
    bottom_cm = if_else(
      is.na(bottom_cm) & !is.na(top_cm) & !is.na(H.Depth.cm.),
      top_cm + as.numeric(H.Depth.cm.),
      bottom_cm
    ),
    top_cm    = as.numeric(top_cm),
    bottom_cm = as.numeric(bottom_cm),
    sand      = as.numeric(lab_sand),
    clay      = as.numeric(lab_clay),
    silt      = as.numeric(lab_silt)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(top_cm), is.finite(bottom_cm),
    bottom_cm > top_cm
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Clip to 0-150 cm window
    top150 = pmax(top_cm, 0),
    bot150 = pmin(bottom_cm, 150),
    thk150 = pmax(0, bot150 - top150)
  ) %>%
  filter(thk150 > 0)

# Weighted mean per pedon
wmean_safe <- function(x, w) {
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(w) & w > 0
  if (!any(ok)) return(NA_real_)
  sum(x[ok] * w[ok]) / sum(w[ok])
}

perry_sand_150 <- perry_hz %>%
  group_by(Point) %>%
  summarise(
    sand_w150 = wmean_safe(sand, thk150),
    clay_w150 = wmean_safe(clay, thk150),
    silt_w150 = wmean_safe(silt, thk150),
    n_hz      = n(),
    n_sand    = sum(!is.na(sand)),
    total_thk = sum(thk150),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Point = as.character(Point))

cat("Pedons with sand data:", sum(!is.na(perry_sand_150$sand_w150)), "\n")
cat("\nSand 0-150cm summary:\n")
summary(perry_sand_150$sand_w150) %>% print()

# Distribution plot
ggplot(perry_sand_150 %>% filter(!is.na(sand_w150)),
       aes(x = sand_w150)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20, fill = "#2c7bb6", color = "white") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Distribution of weighted average sand (0-150cm)",
       x = "Sand (%)", y = "Count")
```

```{r build-model-df}
# ============================================================
# BUILD ONE-ROW-PER-PEDON MODEL DATASET
# ============================================================

# Deduplicate all source tables
cov_dedup <- cov_at_pedons %>%
  mutate(Point = as.character(Point)) %>%
  group_by(Point) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
            .groups = "drop")

pts_xy_dedup <- soil_pts %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(
    coord_X = sf::st_coordinates(soil_pts)[, 1],
    coord_Y = sf::st_coordinates(soil_pts)[, 2],
    Point   = as.character(Point)
  ) %>%
  select(Point, coord_X, coord_Y) %>%
  distinct(Point, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Join
model_df <- cov_dedup %>%
  left_join(perry_sand_150 %>% select(Point, sand_w150),
            by = "Point") %>%
  left_join(pts_xy_dedup, by = "Point") %>%
  filter(!is.na(sand_w150), !is.na(coord_X))

# Hard stop if duplicates
stopifnot(
  "Duplicate Points in model_df!" =
    n_distinct(model_df$Point) == nrow(model_df)
)

cat("Model dataset:\n")
cat("  Pedons:", nrow(model_df), "\n")
cat("  Sand range:", round(min(model_df$sand_w150), 1),
    "-", round(max(model_df$sand_w150), 1), "%\n")
cat("  Sand mean:", round(mean(model_df$sand_w150), 1), "%\n")
cat("  Sand SD:  ", round(sd(model_df$sand_w150), 1), "%\n")

# Covariate columns
cov_cols <- setdiff(names(model_df),
                    c("Point", "sand_w150", "coord_X", "coord_Y"))
cov_cols <- cov_cols[
  vapply(model_df[cov_cols],
         function(x) length(unique(x[is.finite(x)])) > 1,
         logical(1))
]
cat("Covariates:", length(cov_cols), "\n")
```

```{r loocv}
# ============================================================
# LOOCV: RF ON SPATIAL COVARIATES -> SAND 0-150CM
# ============================================================

n <- nrow(model_df)

loocv_results <- tibble(
  Point     = character(n),
  observed  = numeric(n),
  predicted = numeric(n)
)

cat("Running LOOCV (n =", n, ")...\n")

for (i in seq_len(n)) {

  train_i <- model_df[-i, ]
  test_i  <- model_df[i,  ]

  train_x <- train_i %>% select(all_of(cov_cols))
  test_x  <- test_i  %>% select(all_of(cov_cols))

  # Impute with training medians
  col_meds <- vapply(train_x, median, numeric(1), na.rm = TRUE)
  for (nm in cov_cols) {
    train_x[[nm]][is.na(train_x[[nm]])] <- col_meds[nm]
    test_x[[nm]][is.na(test_x[[nm]])]   <- col_meds[nm]
  }

  # Fit RF (regression mode)
  rf_i <- ranger::ranger(
    x             = train_x,
    y             = train_i$sand_w150,
    num.trees     = 1000,
    mtry          = max(2, floor(ncol(train_x) / 3)),
    min.node.size = 5,
    seed          = 42 + i
  )

  pred_i <- predict(rf_i, data = test_x)$predictions

  loocv_results$Point[i]     <- model_df$Point[i]
  loocv_results$observed[i]  <- model_df$sand_w150[i]
  loocv_results$predicted[i] <- pred_i

  if (i %% 10 == 0 || i == n)
    cat("  Fold", i, "/", n, "\n")
}

cat("LOOCV complete.\n")
```

```{r loocv-metrics}
# ============================================================
# LOOCV METRICS
# ============================================================

loocv_results <- loocv_results %>%
  mutate(
    residual = observed - predicted,
    abs_err  = abs(residual)
  )

rmse_loocv <- sqrt(mean(loocv_results$residual^2, na.rm = TRUE))
mae_loocv  <- mean(loocv_results$abs_err, na.rm = TRUE)
r2_loocv   <- cor(loocv_results$observed,
                  loocv_results$predicted,
                  use = "complete.obs")^2
bias_loocv <- mean(loocv_results$residual, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("LOOCV RESULTS: Sand 0-150cm\n")
cat("============================================================\n")
cat("RMSE: ", round(rmse_loocv, 2), "%\n")
cat("MAE:  ", round(mae_loocv,  2), "%\n")
cat("R²:   ", round(r2_loocv,   3), "\n")
cat("Bias: ", round(bias_loocv, 2), "%\n")

# Observed vs predicted plot
p_ov <- ggplot(loocv_results, aes(x = observed, y = predicted)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, color = "#2c7bb6", size = 2) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,
              linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,
              color = "#d73027", fill = "#fdae61", alpha = 0.2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title    = "LOOCV: Observed vs Predicted Sand (0-150cm)",
    subtitle = paste0("R² = ", round(r2_loocv, 3),
                      "  |  RMSE = ", round(rmse_loocv, 2), "%",
                      "  |  MAE = ", round(mae_loocv, 2), "%"),
    x = "Observed Sand (%)",
    y = "Predicted Sand (%)"
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf,
           label = paste0("n = ", nrow(loocv_results)),
           hjust = 1.2, vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5, color = "grey40")

print(p_ov)
ggsave("../outputs/spatial/loocv_sand_obs_vs_pred.png",
       p_ov, width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 200)

# Residual map
resid_sf <- loocv_results %>%
  left_join(pts_xy_dedup, by = "Point") %>%
  filter(!is.na(coord_X)) %>%
  sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("coord_X", "coord_Y"),
               crs = sf::st_crs(soil_pts))

p_resid <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = resid_sf, aes(color = residual, size = abs_err)) +
  scale_color_gradient2(low = "#d73027", mid = "white",
                        high = "#1a9641", midpoint = 0,
                        name = "Residual\n(obs - pred)") +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 5), name = "|Error|") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title    = "LOOCV Residuals — Sand 0-150cm",
       subtitle = "Red = underpredicted  |  Green = overpredicted")
print(p_resid)
ggsave("../outputs/spatial/loocv_sand_residuals_map.png",
       p_resid, width = 8, height = 7, dpi = 200)

write.csv(loocv_results,
          "../outputs/spatial/loocv_sand_results.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r fit-final-rf}
# ============================================================
# FIT FINAL RF ON ALL PEDONS
# ============================================================

full_x <- model_df %>% select(all_of(cov_cols))
col_meds_full <- vapply(full_x, median, numeric(1), na.rm = TRUE)
for (nm in cov_cols) {
  full_x[[nm]][is.na(full_x[[nm]])] <- col_meds_full[nm]
}

set.seed(42)
rf_final <- ranger::ranger(
  x             = full_x,
  y             = model_df$sand_w150,
  num.trees     = 1500,
  mtry          = max(2, floor(length(cov_cols) / 3)),
  min.node.size = 5,
  importance    = "permutation",
  seed          = 42
)

cat("Final RF:\n")
cat("  OOB RMSE:", round(sqrt(rf_final$prediction.error), 2), "%\n")
cat("  R² (OOB):", round(rf_final$r.squared, 3), "\n")

# Variable importance
imp_df <- tibble(
  variable   = names(rf_final$variable.importance),
  importance = rf_final$variable.importance
) %>%
  arrange(desc(importance)) %>%
  mutate(variable = fct_reorder(variable, importance))

cat("\nTop 15 most important covariates:\n")
imp_df %>% slice_head(n = 15) %>%
  mutate(importance = round(importance, 4)) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% print()

p_imp <- ggplot(imp_df %>% slice_head(n = 20),
                aes(x = importance, y = variable)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2c7bb6") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Variable Importance — Spatial RF (Sand 0-150cm)",
       x = "Permutation Importance", y = NULL)
print(p_imp)
ggsave("../outputs/spatial/imp_sand_rf.png",
       p_imp, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 200)

# In-sample predictions for residual kriging
insample_pred <- rf_final$predictions
```

```{r variogram}
# ============================================================
# VARIOGRAM ON RF RESIDUALS
# ============================================================

resid_krige_df <- tibble(
  coord_X  = model_df$coord_X,
  coord_Y  = model_df$coord_Y,
  observed = model_df$sand_w150,
  rf_pred  = insample_pred,
  residual = observed - rf_pred
)

resid_krige_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(
  resid_krige_df,
  coords = c("coord_X", "coord_Y"),
  crs    = sf::st_crs(soil_pts)
)

cat("Residual summary:\n")
summary(resid_krige_df$residual) %>% print()

# Empirical variogram
vgm_emp <- gstat::variogram(residual ~ 1, data = resid_krige_sf)

# Try fitting Spherical, then Exponential
vgm_fit <- tryCatch(
  gstat::fit.variogram(vgm_emp, gstat::vgm("Sph")),
  error = function(e) tryCatch(
    gstat::fit.variogram(vgm_emp, gstat::vgm("Exp")),
    error = function(e2) NULL
  )
)

if (!is.null(vgm_fit)) {
  cat("\nVariogram model fitted:\n")
  cat("  Model:", as.character(vgm_fit$model[2]), "\n")
  cat("  Nugget:", round(vgm_fit$psill[1], 4), "\n")
  cat("  Sill:  ", round(sum(vgm_fit$psill), 4), "\n")
  cat("  Range: ", round(vgm_fit$range[2], 1), "map units\n")

  p_vgm <- plot(vgm_emp, vgm_fit,
                main = "Variogram of RF residuals — Sand 0-150cm")
  print(p_vgm)
} else {
  cat("Variogram fitting failed -- will use RF only.\n")
}
```

```{r wall-to-wall}
# ============================================================
# WALL-TO-WALL PREDICTION: RF + KRIGING CORRECTION
# ============================================================

cat("Building pixel data frame...\n")
cov_df <- terra::as.data.frame(
  cov_stack[[cov_cols]], xy = TRUE, na.rm = FALSE
)
n_pixels <- nrow(cov_df)
cat("Total pixels:", n_pixels, "\n")

# Impute NAs
cov_pred <- cov_df %>%
  select(all_of(cov_cols)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.finite(.x), .x, NA_real_)))
for (nm in cov_cols) {
  cov_pred[[nm]][is.na(cov_pred[[nm]])] <- col_meds_full[nm]
}

# Predict in chunks
chunk_size <- 50000
n_chunks   <- ceiling(n_pixels / chunk_size)
pred_list  <- vector("list", n_chunks)

cat("Predicting in", n_chunks, "chunks...\n")
for (i in seq_len(n_chunks)) {
  idx <- ((i-1)*chunk_size + 1):min(i*chunk_size, n_pixels)
  pred_list[[i]] <- predict(
    rf_final,
    data = cov_pred[idx, , drop = FALSE]
  )$predictions
  if (i %% 5 == 0 || i == n_chunks)
    cat("  Chunk", i, "/", n_chunks, "\n")
}

rf_pred_vec <- unlist(pred_list)

# Build RF prediction raster
sand_rf_rast <- terra::rast(cov_stack[[1]])
terra::values(sand_rf_rast) <- rf_pred_vec
names(sand_rf_rast) <- "sand_rf"

cat("RF prediction raster built.\n")
cat("  Predicted sand range:",
    round(min(rf_pred_vec, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "-",
    round(max(rf_pred_vec, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "%\n")

# ---- Kriging correction ----
if (!is.null(vgm_fit)) {
  cat("Kriging residuals...\n")

  # Prediction grid
  pred_grid <- terra::as.data.frame(
    cov_stack[[1]], xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE
  ) %>%
    select(x, y) %>%
    sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("x", "y"),
                 crs = sf::st_crs(soil_pts))

  krige_result <- tryCatch(
    gstat::krige(
      formula   = residual ~ 1,
      locations = resid_krige_sf,
      newdata   = pred_grid,
      model     = vgm_fit,
      debug.level = 0
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      cat("Kriging failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
      NULL
    }
  )

  if (!is.null(krige_result)) {
    # Build kriging correction raster
    krige_sf <- krige_result %>%
      mutate(krige_val = var1.pred) %>%
      select(krige_val)

    krige_rast <- terra::rasterize(
      terra::vect(krige_sf),
      cov_stack[[1]],
      field = "krige_val",
      fun   = "mean"
    )

    # Final map = RF prediction + kriged residual
    sand_rk_rast <- sand_rf_rast + krige_rast
    names(sand_rk_rast) <- "sand_rk"

    cat("Regression kriging correction applied.\n")
    cat("  Final sand range:",
        round(min(terra::values(sand_rk_rast), na.rm = TRUE), 1), "-",
        round(max(terra::values(sand_rk_rast), na.rm = TRUE), 1), "%\n")

    # Also build kriging variance raster (uncertainty map)
    krige_var_sf <- krige_result %>%
      mutate(var_val = var1.var) %>%
      select(var_val)

    krige_var_rast <- terra::rasterize(
      terra::vect(krige_var_sf),
      cov_stack[[1]],
      field = "var_val",
      fun   = "mean"
    )
    names(krige_var_rast) <- "sand_krige_variance"

  } else {
    sand_rk_rast   <- sand_rf_rast
    krige_var_rast <- NULL
    cat("Using RF-only prediction.\n")
  }
} else {
  sand_rk_rast   <- sand_rf_rast
  krige_var_rast <- NULL
  cat("Using RF-only prediction (no variogram).\n")
}

# Save rasters
terra::writeRaster(sand_rf_rast,
                   "../outputs/spatial/sand_150_rf.tif",
                   overwrite = TRUE)
terra::writeRaster(sand_rk_rast,
                   "../outputs/spatial/sand_150_rk.tif",
                   overwrite = TRUE)
if (!is.null(krige_var_rast)) {
  terra::writeRaster(krige_var_rast,
                     "../outputs/spatial/sand_150_krige_variance.tif",
                     overwrite = TRUE)
}
cat("Rasters saved.\n")
```

```{r visualize}
  )
print(p_ov_series)
ggsave("../outputs/spatial/loocv_sand_obs_pred_by_series.png",
       p_ov_series, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 200)

#The RF model explained 37% of variance in weighted mean sand content (0–150cm), with LOOCV RMSE of 12.0%. Elevation was the dominant predictor, consistent with the catenary relationship between landscape position and soil texture in the Southern Coastal Plain. Residuals showed moderate spatial autocorrelation (nugget/sill = 0.54, range = 365m), supporting application of regression kriging correction.
```
